gameData.backstory: Whispers follow 'Rhythm Wrecker' through Subchain City. Some say he was a renowned musician before the DRIP dried up, others claim he was a tech wiz who mastered the perfect backbeat to crack any blockchain. Now, he uses his rhythmic skills to predict enemy movements and exploit vulnerabilities – all while searching for his lost golden snare drum.
gameData.name: Rhythm Wrecker
gameData.personality: Eccentric: Rhythm Wrecker sees patterns in everything, often leading to seemingly nonsensical but surprisingly accurate predictions. Unpredictable: You never know if he'll help, hinder, or start drumming on a corpse. Loyal (to his flock): Despite his weirdness, Rhythm Wrecker fiercely protects his flock, laying down a beat of defiance against any threat.

specialAbility.description: Rhythm Wrecker uses his drumsticks to create sonic disruptions. 'Sonic Pulse' acts as an temporary shield, creating a barrier that absorbs damage based on Rhythm Wrecker's proximity to DRIP. If no DRIP is available the power of the shield is substantially reduced.
specialAbility.name: Sonic Pulse
